column3: NKJV has “does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “does not confess Jesus.”
NKJV has “We love Him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “We love.”
NKJV has “how can he love God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “cannot love God.”
